architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context for global state).

tickets.title: Convert Stitch dashboard home screen to React page
tickets.description: Create src/pages/DashboardHome.jsx. Replicate exact layout, colors, typography from Stitch HTML. Use Tailwind classes. Extract reusable components (e.g., Card, ProgressBar) to src/components/. Hardcode mock data for now. Ensure responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Reusable Card and ProgressBar components extracted

tickets.title: Convert Stitch homework search screen to React page
tickets.description: Create src/pages/HomeworkSearch.jsx. Replicate search bar, filters, results list. Use Tailwind. Extract SearchBar and HomeworkCard components. Hardcode mock data. Add client-side search/filter logic (case-insensitive, partial match).
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match to Stitch screen_2_homework_search
Search and filter work with mock data

tickets.title: Convert Stitch calendar exams schedule screen to React page
tickets.description: Create src/pages/CalendarExams.jsx. Replicate calendar grid, exam cards, month navigation. Use Tailwind. Extract CalendarGrid and ExamCard components. Hardcode mock exam data. Add month navigation (prev/next buttons).

tickets.title: Convert Stitch transaction detail screen to React page
tickets.description: Create src/pages/TransactionDetail.jsx. Replicate transaction header, timeline, payment breakdown. Use Tailwind. Extract Timeline and PaymentBreakdown components. Hardcode mock data. Add print button (opens print dialog).
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match to Stitch detail_transaksi
Print button triggers browser print dialog

tickets.title: Create shared layout and navigation components
tickets.description: Create src/components/Layout.jsx (header, sidebar, main content). Create src/components/Navbar.jsx (top navigation). Extract common UI elements (Logo, UserDropdown) to src/components/. Use Tailwind. Ensure sidebar collapsible on mobile.

tickets.title: Set up React Router and global state
tickets.description: Create src/App.jsx. Configure React Router v6 routes for all pages. Add global state context (src/context/AppContext.jsx) for user auth and theme. Wrap app with context providers. Add 404 page (src/pages/NotFound.jsx).
acceptance_criteria: All routes load correct page component

tickets.title: Add error boundaries and loading states
tickets.description: Create src/components/ErrorBoundary.jsx. Wrap all page components with ErrorBoundary. Add loading skeletons (src/components/Skeleton.jsx) for async data. Add 500 error page (src/pages/ServerError.jsx).
acceptance_criteria: ErrorBoundary catches errors in child components
Loading skeletons show during async operations

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Finalize src/App.jsx. Integrate Layout, Navbar, Router. Add route-based code splitting (React.lazy). Set up base Tailwind config (src/tailwind.config.js) with project colors. Add global CSS reset (src/index.css).
acceptance_criteria: All pages render within Layout component
Tailwind config matches Stitch design tokens
